0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Warriors visit the Lakers, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, while Stephen Curry is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. Los Angeles has Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton and Jarred Vanderbilt listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Warriors lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 119-103 defeat in San Francisco on April 9, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Golden State a 35% chance to win.
